description: This file defines the PointNode class, a subclass of PcbNode, representing a point with coordinates and an optional angle in a PCB-related data structure. It includes constructors for creating points from different input formats, methods for spatial calculations, and transformations.

classes.name: PointNode
classes.description: Represents a point with x, y coordinates and an optional angle, with methods for spatial operations and transformations.

methods.name: PointNode(String nodeName, int i, List<Object> children)
methods.description: Constructs a PointNode from a list of child objects, parsing coordinates and optional angle.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y)
methods.description: Creates a PointNode at the specified (x, y) coordinates with angle defaulting to 0.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y, double angle)
methods.description: Creates a PointNode at the specified (x, y) coordinates with a specific angle.

methods.name: isConnected(PointNode at, SizeNode size)
methods.description: Determines if this point is connected to another point within a size threshold.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PointNode.

methods.name: translate(PointNode at)
methods.description: Translates the point relative to another PointNode, applying rotation based on the point's angle.

methods.name: setLocation(double x, double y)
methods.description: Sets the x and y coordinates of the PointNode.
